title: wilcoxia lazaro-cardenasii
intro: Wilcoxia lazaro-cardenasii, commonly known as Wilcoxia, is a plant species that belongs to the family Asteraceae. Wilcoxia lazaro-cardenasii has been traditionally used in Mexican folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including gastrointestinal issues and inflammation, due to its potential health benefits such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include soothing digestive issues and reducing inflammation, which can be attributed to its ability to inhibit pro-inflammatory enzymes and scavenge free radicals. The bioactive constituents of Wilcoxia lazaro-cardenasii include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
